chapters.title: The Great Day of the Lord Near
chapters.synopsis: Zephaniah declares that the Lord will utterly consume all things from off the land, beginning with those who worship Baal and swear by Malcham. The great day of the Lord is near, a day of wrath, trouble, distress, and darkness, when the Lord will search Jerusalem with candles to punish the settled and complacent.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord will consume all things from the land

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The day of the Lord: search of Jerusalem with candles

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The great day of the Lord is near, a day of wrath

chapters.title: Seek the Lord Before Judgment
chapters.synopsis: Zephaniah calls the nation to gather itself together and seek the Lord, seeking righteousness and meekness before the fierce anger of the Lord comes. Judgment falls on Philistia, Moab, Ammon, and Ethiopia, and Nineveh itself, once mighty, is made a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in.

segments.note: Gather yourselves; seek the Lord, righteousness, meekness

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Judgment on Philistia, Moab, Ammon, and Ethiopia

segments.note: Nineveh made a desolation, a place for beasts

chapters.title: The Lord Will Rejoice Over Thee
chapters.synopsis: Woe is pronounced on the filthy and rebellious city, Jerusalem, whose officials and prophets are corrupt though the Lord in her midst is righteous. Yet the Lord promises to give the people a pure language, leave a humble remnant that trusts in his name, and himself rejoice over Zion with singing, gathering the outcast and turning their captivity.

segments.speaker: the-lord
